from scipy.interpolate import BSpline
def bsbasis(arr,nk=8,deg=3):
    lo,hi=arr.min()-1e-9,arr.max()+1e-9
    inner=np.linspace(lo,hi,nk)
    knots=np.r_[[lo]*deg,inner,[hi]*deg]
    n=len(knots)-deg-1
    B=np.zeros((len(arr),n))
    for i in range(n):
        c=np.zeros(n); c[i]=1
        B[:,i]=BSpline(knots,c,deg,extrapolate=False)(arr)
    return np.nan_to_num(B)
